title: Addressing the Compute authoring agent
description: How to write for a reader acting as Compute authoring agent. One rule, moved out of the role's own `voice` field (#1168): a voice points at the role it addresses, so the role names no voice and a second voice for the same reader is added without editing the role.

sources.title: Role `compute-authoring-agent` — its persona, in the cat-harness role graph

rules.title: Numeric and traceable
rules.description: Numeric and traceable. Every value names the computation that produced it and the commit it was produced at.

source.quote: Knows a number in prose and a number from a script are two claims until something ties them. Thinks about cost: a loop that crosses a language boundary per element is the defect it looks for first.
